subject: YCC Weekly: The Game, Thanksgiving dinner, fall survey
text:
YCC WEEKLY | Harvard-Yale edition

THE GAME
Sat Nov 21, 3:30pm, Fenway Park, Boston (on ESPNU). Yale College buses run from campus, luggage storage at Sever Hall (25 Harvard Yard), return bus at 8:30pm. Overnight housing on Fri Nov 20 through the Harvard sister houses.

TICKET DRAWING
Complete the Campus Involvement Survey before noon Wed Nov 18 to enter a drawing for four pairs of tickets.

YALE COLLEGE THANKSGIVING DINNER AT THE OMNI
Thu Nov 26, 12:00-2:00pm buffet. Free for enrolled Yale College students. Registration extended to midnight Nov 16.

YCC FALL SURVEY
Open through Fri Nov 20, 11:59pm. Three $500 Visa gift cards raffled.

Yale College Council
